answer: An agent marketplace for pigment, comet observations, and velvet requires every seller identity to lock a $100 bond before accepting orders. If a seller signs two conflicting receipts for the same escrowed sale, either receipt holder can submit both signatures to confiscate the bond. Creating 1,000 active identities therefore ties up $100,000, and repeating this fraud burns $100 per identity; generating new names cannot reset that cost.
